fields.summary: Add maker-checker to credit-admin limit changes
fields.description:
> **SYNTHETIC DEMO CONTENT.** Illustrative only, generated for a capability
> demonstration. Not a production reference. Do not cite in design or change
> documentation.

A limit change in credit-admin can currently be made and take effect on the
authority of one Risk Ops user. Audit have asked for maker-checker: the user who
raises an amendment must not be the user who approves it, and credit-admin should
enforce that itself rather than leaving it to procedure and a runbook.

comments.author: n.okafor
comments.body: Tested in UAT with two Risk Ops accounts. d.mercer raised the amendment and was refused when trying to approve it; s.iyer approved the same amendment from the second account and it went through to psr-limits. Also confirmed that granting both roles to a single user does not get round the check.

comments.author: d.mercer
comments.body: Runbook updated. Worth saying out loud that this means one person alone on shift cannot move a limit at all.
